_comment: Merge these into the generated Packages/manifest.json 'dependencies' after creating the Unity 6 project. Versions were current when written (AR Foundation 6.x requires Unity 6000.0+); taking newer patch versions from Package Manager is fine.

_why_each.com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json: Required. Assets/Scripts/Core parses the API with it; nothing compiles without it.
_why_each.com.unity.xr.arfoundation: Optional for an Editor run, required on a device. Enables the ArQuestTrail.ARFoundation assembly (depth occlusion, SR-VIS-01/02).
_why_each.com.unity.xr.arcore / arkit: The platform providers AR Foundation drives on Android / iOS.
_why_each.com.google.ar.core.arfoundation.extensio: Geospatial / VPS (SR-GEO-03). Enables the ArQuestTrail.ARCore assembly. Not in Unity's registry, hence the git URL; check Google's docs for the current tag.
